title: Head of Supply Chain (f/m/d) - Berlin
description:
About us

At CYCLE, we're redefining urban mobility for the people who keep cities moving: couriers, riders, and delivery pros. Our e-bike subscription service combines durable vehicles, fast repairs, and real support, everything riders need to stay on the road.
From Berlin to London, Vienna to Amsterdam, we operate in 200+ cities across Europe, providing thousands of riders with bikes built for work, not for show.
Our mission is simple: make last-mile delivery more reliable, affordable, and sustainable, one ride at a time. With every bike we deploy, we're helping build the backbone of smarter, greener cities.
Ride with us into the future - sustainable, efficient, and full speed ahead!


Your Mission

As Head of Supply Chain, you own every part of how physical goods reach our fleet and our riders, from the purchase order to the shelf to the courier's bike. You report to our Director of Operations and work directly with Hardware, Finance, Software and our country teams. In particular you will:

  • Own supply chain end to end: Purchasing, warehousing, stock keeping and outbound logistics across our European network, as one function with one owner. You ultimately ensure we have the right number of bikes, batteries and parts at the right time, the right place and the best price.
  • Oversee our assembly & refurbishment activities: Manage our assembly and refurbishment partners, own the bills of material for everything we build from purchased components as well as internal refurbishment within our locations.
  • Own the systems, not just the process: Take full responsibility for our ERP and warehouse management setup for all supply chain topics, from data model and master data through to daily execution – you will be the business owner to our software team and guide implementation.
  • Professionalize the structure: Design and implement the processes, controls and physical setup our growing operation needs, and then get your hands dirty making them real and ensuring your organization internalizes them.
  • Own the numbers behind the goods: You will guide the rest of the company on such topics as transfer prices, landed cost allocation and other supply-chain related financials, ensuring each business line's P&L is accurately reflecting parts consumption and asset usage – together with our Finance team.
  • Drive the agenda across teams: Set priorities, align Hardware, Finance and Tech behind them, and hold the line when it matters. 
  • Partner with the larger organization and understand your impact on them: All you do, you do with the end goal in mind to become the best friend of our Local and Country Operations and Sales teams, who all depend on your fulfillment excellence to grow and maintain their businesses.
  • Lead and grow your team: Build a supply chain organization that scales with us across markets.


Your skills and qualifications

We are looking for someone who has built structure inside a well-run company and is ready to build it again from scratch, with their sleeves rolled up. Ideally you bring:

  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience, of which at least 5 in a managerial supply chain or operations role.
  • Experience leading a team of at least 3 direct reports in a supply chain or operations-heavy function.
  • Structure from an established company: You have worked inside proper processes and systems and know what good looks like.
  • 0 to 1 experience: You have also built something from nothing in a smaller or fast-moving company or demonstrated you can excel in such a setting, and you are comfortable being scrappy when that is what the situation needs.
  • Commercial and financial fluency: Working capital optimization, inter-company transactions or product costing,  are all familiar territory for you.
  • Cross-functional communication: You can carry a topic across teams and drive it to a decision.
  • Ownership and a firm, professional attitude: You take the whole problem, not your part of it.
  • English at C1 level or above

Nice to have:
  • Hands-on experience with Odoo or a comparable ERP, ideally including experience in shaping or designing a system for supply chain topics rather than execution alone.
  • Background in bike, scooter, mobility or another hardware-heavy industry where physical goods move between internal as well as external locations.
  • German or Dutch


What you can expect from us


  • Exciting industry: You will work in the dynamic world of mobility, which is a constantly evolving sector.
  • Real impact: Your work improves the lives of many bike couriers.
  • Take on immediate responsibility: Start making a difference right away and implement your own ideas. Boredom? Not a chance!
  • Shape the future: As part of our growing start-up, you will help to shape tomorrow's mobility.
  • International team & Strong network: Work alongside motivated colleagues from all over the world. Teamwork is very important to us.
  • Fair conditions: We offer a stable employment with attractive salary, €50 HRmony voucher, a company e-bike, modern equipment and 28 days' holiday a year.


Diversity

At CYCLE, we believe diversity makes us stronger. No matter who you are, where you're from, or what makes you unique, you're welcome here.

description:
Your Impact

Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part is not the software, it is that every customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that is where most enterprise AI value quietly dies.

Forward Deployed Engineering is how we close that gap. You sit inside the customer's environment, build in their production data, and turn what you learn there into product. You are one of the first FDEs at Tacto, so you are not slotting into a playbook, you are writing it while shipping in real accounts.

Your Tasks

Build in customer environments. Data pipelines, agents, and custom logic on top of the Tacto platform, in real production data.

Own the technical side of a deployment. Extraction, mapping, validation, enrichment, until the customer's procurement team can actually work with the result.

Be in the room, on site. Run data workshops with key users, debug alongside their IT, and see how a company really buys instead of how the process documentation says it buys.

Turn what you learn at the edge into product. Document the pattern and push it to Product and Engineering instead of quietly rebuilding the same one-off for the next customer.

Automate your own job. If a step in a deployment can be done by an agent, you build the agent and prove it works.

Make it one team. Hold the boundary with Solution Engineering and Customer Value so the customer experiences one Tacto, not three.

Your Profile

  • You are a builder. You have shipped software, automations, agents, or technical projects that real users relied on.

  • You write code yourself. You are comfortable with Python and SQL and use AI coding tools to move fast.

  • You have 0-4 years of experience with evidence of a steep learning curve through strong technical work, ambitious startups, internships, or things you built from zero.

Why This Role is Awesome

You get to combine building software with seeing exactly how it creates value in the real world. You will ship into production, work directly with industrial customers, and turn what you learn at the edge into product improvements. Do this well for 12 to 18 months and you are among the people who defined what Forward Deployed Engineering means at Tacto, with a direct line into the product roadmap and an obvious next step, whether that is leading a team, going deeper into product, or owning a segment.

What This Role Is, and Isn't

We want to be honest about what you are signing up for.

  • This is not an engineering role with customers kept at a safe distance. Customer contact is the job, not a tax on the job. If you want a ticket queue and clean requirements, this is the wrong role.

  • The deal: prove yourself, deliver real impact, make a strong case for yourself, then we back your next step in every way we can.

Why Tacto

We bet on young talent and mean it. We consistently back smart, hungry, young people with real ownership early. 70%+ of our Leadership Team was promoted internally: you deliver impact and sky is the limit at Tacto.

Backed to win big. We are Sequoia and Index-funded with €50M+ behind us. Our founders sit at the same table as the people defining the global AI agenda. We're building Tacto to be the lighthouse for European industrial AI.

A truly AI-native organization, with every resource you could dream of. All the leading AI tools and custom agents at your fingertips, plus dedicated people who keep us at the frontier.

High bar, high speed, genuinely fun. You'll be surrounded by extremely smart and ambitious people who set the bar high and push you to get better every week. Intense, fast, and the opposite of boring.

A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem. Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events (Lunch & Learns, hackathons, community gatherings). Check out all upcoming and past events here: https://luma.com/tacto

You'll build something that lasts and that matters. You'll help build the company that keeps European industry competitive for the long term.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

title: Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem
description:
Your mission

As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem, you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.

ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.

Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.

You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.

Your day-to-day 
  • Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
  • Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
  • Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
  • Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
  • Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner, balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
  • Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
  • Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.
  • Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.


Your profile

At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.

  • You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions.
  • You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value.
  • You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments.
  • You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed.
  • You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like.
  • You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined.
  • You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority.
  • You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences.
  • You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.
  • You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

  • Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services.
  • Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management.
  • Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems.
  • APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations.
  • Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems.
  • Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale.
Direct Android Product Management experience is an advantage, but not essential if you bring strong Product Management expertise and relevant experience from an adjacent enterprise technology ecosystem.


Why us?

This is an opportunity to shape an important part of a category that is still being defined. 
Android gives ProGlove access to a much broader technology ecosystem, but the opportunity goes far beyond compatibility. You will help determine what role ProGlove should play in that ecosystem, which capabilities we should own, where we should partner, what customers and developers should be able to build around us, and where integration itself can become a source of differentiation and recurring business value. 
ProGlove already has the customer base, market credibility, technology and industrial expertise to build on. Our products are used in some of the world's most demanding operational environments. What we are now building is the next layer. 
Over time, success will mean more than making our own products easier to integrate. It will mean creating capabilities, interfaces and ecosystem relationships that customers, application providers and partners actively choose to build around - moving ProGlove from ecosystem participant toward ecosystem shaper. 
If you are excited by the idea of turning complex technology ecosystems into simple, valuable products - and helping shape how the next generation of frontline technology connects with the digital world - we would love to meet you. 
Join us in building the future of frontline work.


What success looks like

  • ProGlove has a clear, customer-backed strategy and prioritized roadmap for Android integration and ecosystem capabilities.
  • Recurring customer and integration needs are turned into scalable, repeatable solutions rather than one-off engineering projects.
  • Customers can adopt, integrate, deploy and manage ProGlove devices more easily within their existing enterprise environments.
  • Decisions about what ProGlove should own, enable or partner are made transparently and based on customer value, business impact and long-term scalability.
  • Product, Engineering, Sales and Solution Architecture are aligned on priorities, supported capabilities and key trade-offs.
  • Customer-facing teams can confidently communicate our Android proposition and common deployment patterns without relying on Product or Engineering in every opportunity.
  • Relevant integrations, partnerships and commercial opportunities are identified, validated and translated into tangible product or business outcomes.


Meet your team

You will join our Product team and report directly to the CPO. You will work especially closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion, as well as colleagues across Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture and Product Marketing.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will bring together customer needs, technical realities and commercial opportunities, while also building relationships with external technology partners, platform providers and integrators. The team values open collaboration, clear communication and shared ownership of outcomes.

title: Staff/Senior Software Engineer - Hydris - Golang (d/f/m)
description:
New Challenge

About Us 
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a Germany-based DefenseTech company with offices in Berlin and Munich. We network market-available sensors, effectors, or situational awareness systems into a tactical IoT backbone that reliably provides armed forces and security agencies with cross-domain information superiority — automated, scalable, and cost-efficient.

Our solutions integrate seamlessly into existing defense and maritime infrastructures, delivering fast data fusion and AI-enhanced analytics for robust situational awareness in dynamic environments. We build platform-agnostic systems that enable real interoperability across domains.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll directly impact the technical direction of our orchestration products – Hydris – the coordination engine for sensors and mission systems, and the interoperability API that underpins it. 

You'll work at the layer where heterogeneous real-world systems like radars, AIS receivers, LoRa mesh radios, satellite feeds, and C2 platforms become a single coherent picture. The problems lie in distributed systems, protocols, and data modeling areas. They play out in environments that are bandwidth-constrained, intermittently connected, and operationally unforgiving. 

The role is deeply hands-on, but it expects you to shape what we build and how we build it, not just deliver what's specified.

What you'll do
Core engine development

  • Design and build the systems that power Hydris.
  • Go is your primary language. You should be comfortable reading Rust and TypeScript across the codebase, even if you're not writing in them day-to-day.
  • Own the architecture of a system that must run reliably on edge hardware, in disconnected mesh networks, and at scale — often all of that simultaneously.
Protocol and integration architecture
  • Evolve the schema that defines how every sensor, asset, and mission system talks to Hydris.
  • Make API design decisions that hold up across our client libraries without creating a maintenance burden.
  • Continue refining the integration framework that lets Hydris connect to new sensor types, data sources, and command systems.
  • Set the patterns for how built-in integrations (ADS-B, AIS, ASTERIX, Meshtastic, SpaceTrack, TAK, federation) are structured, tested, and maintained.
  • Make it straightforward for external developers and system vendors to build their own plugins/integrations to Hydris.
Distributed systems
  • Architect the peer-to-peer mesh and federation layer that keeps Hydris operational in disconnected, denied, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth environments.
  • Solve the hard coordination problems: conflict resolution across federated nodes, eventual consistency of entity state, and track correlation across unreliable links.
  • Ensure the system degrades gracefully rather than failing completely when connectivity is lost or constrained.
Technical leadership
  • Set technical standards for the codebase: how we test distributed behavior, how we handle protocol versioning, how we think about backward compatibility in an API-first product.
  • Review code with a focus on long-term maintainability and operational correctness, not just feature completion.
  • Make build-versus-integrate decisions and help the team clearly understand the trade-offs.

You should apply if you
  • Have built and shipped distributed systems that run in production, ideally in environments where reliability matters more than convenience.
  • Are comfortable working across the stack, from Protobuf schema design and systems-level Go, to the TypeScript that puts a map in front of a user.
  • Have well-formed views about API design and protocol evolution, informed by experience maintaining APIs that other people depend on.
  • Can operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy but are adept at collaboration with colleagues toward high-quality technical decisions, at scale.
  • Are interested in contributing to European military, maritime, and critical infrastructure defence systems.
  • Write clearly and communicate architectural decisions in a way that survives beyond the conversation where they were made. 
  • Working language is English. German is not required.
You'd be a great fit with
  • Experience with geospatial systems, sensor fusion, or track management.
  • Familiarity with defense or ISR data standards like CoT/TAK, ASTERIX, SAPIENT, MIL-STD-2525.
  • Background in networking, mesh architectures, or systems designed for contested or degraded communication environments.
  • Experience working on developer-facing open-source infrastructure where adoption depends on the quality of the API and documentation.

We Offer
  • Remote work anywhere in Germany, or hybrid/on-site in Berlin or Munich if you're already based there and prefer an office.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership, a flat structure, and real input into technical direction.
  • Annual €1500 Learning & development budget (available after probation).
  • Bike Leasing and Urban Sports Club membership.
  • 30 days of paid time off.
Note: We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role – candidates must already be eligible to work in Germany.

Perfect, let's talk!

title: Mechanical Engineer  | Robotics
description:
We build humanoid systems: full stack, from hardware and electronics to software and manufacturing, all in-house in Berlin.

At Cell Labs, we push the boundary of what robotics can achieve. Our goal is clear: to build systems that empower humans, not replace them. Our technology is already deployed with industry leading customers and partners. Now, our own product is close to launch.

The quiet phase is over. We are looking for people who want to be here early, take ownership, and help us build what others only talk about.

Location: Berlin (on-site) Start: Asap Employment Type: Full-time

Tasks

  • Mechanical Design & CAD: Design and develop mechanical components and assemblies for humanoid systems, from actuators and kinematic mechanisms to sensor mounts and protective enclosures and model them in CAD (e.g. Onshape).
  • Actuator Kinematics: Design and optimize the kinematic structure of the robot's joints and limbs, including joint layouts, degrees of freedom, ranges of motion, and transmission mechanisms. Select and integrate actuators (motors, gearboxes, encoders) so that torque, speed, and load requirements are met across the full motion range.
  • Production Readiness: Optimize designs for series production with product requirements, user experience, and target cost in mind. Prepare the handover to manufacturing, including assembly processes, jigs and fixtures, and supplier ramp-up.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Prototype and validate mechanical systems for performance, safety, and durability. Design and build test rigs for actuators and subassemblies, including endurance and load testing.
  • Electronics Integration & Wiring: Integrate PCBs, sensors, and batteries into mechanical assemblies, including cable routing and heat management. Build and solder cables and wiring harnesses for prototypes and test setups.
  • Analysis & Materials: Run stress analysis and weight optimization to improve performance and longevity. Research, test, and qualify new materials and processes, such as composites and additive manufacturing.
  • Documentation & Specifications: Maintain complete design documentation, including drawings, part specifications, BOMs, and wiring diagrams, with full traceability throughout development.

Requirements

  • Background: You studied mechanical engineering, mechatronics, robotics, electrical engineering, or something close to it.
  • Experience: At least 3 years working on robotic systems, mobile machinery, or similar electromechanical products. What you built matters more to us than where you built it.
  • Mechanical Design: You've designed complex mechanical systems and understand robot kinematics, actuators, and how mechanical and electrical parts come together in a working robot.
  • Manufacturing: You know CNC machining, injection molding, sheet metal, and additive manufacturing, and you design with mid- and high-volume production in mind. You've worked with suppliers and brought hardware into production.
  • Hands-on: You like building things yourself. You solder cables, put together wiring harnesses, build test rigs, and track down problems on the bench.
  • Tools: You work confidently in Onshape and Autodesk Fusion, including its electronics design tools.
  • Product lifecycle: Ideally, you've taken at least one hardware product all the way from concept to series production.
  • How you work: You get a first prototype built quickly and improve from there. You can keep several projects moving at once and know when a design is good enough to move forward.
  • Languages: Fluent English. German is a plus.

Benefits

  • Your work goes into a real robot: The joints, assemblies, and test rigs you design end up in humanoid robots we build ourselves. You take ownership of real subsystems and see them go from CAD to working hardware.
  • Everything under one roof: Office, workshop, and test rigs are in the same building in Kreuzberg. Your design goes from screen to prototype in days. The electrical and software engineers are a short walk away, not a ticket**.**
  • Room to grow: Paid learning time and a personal budget for courses, conferences, and the tools you need. You'll get space to try new materials, processes, and ideas, and you'll take on more responsibility as the company grows.
  • Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, health, food, or fitness. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about.

Send us your CV and a few projects you've worked on. Ideally, include a mechanical system you designed and built yourself, with a short note on the challenges and how you solved them. No cover letter needed.

Process: Intro call → Technical deep-dive → On-site visit → Offer

We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in engineering and tech. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway.

description:
Werkstudentenstelle · 15–20 h/Woche · 100 % remote

Über FLOWZOOM

Wir sind FLOWZOOM – eine Marke für hochwertige, innovative Reiseprodukte. Unser Fokus liegt auf Reisekissen, die Komfort, Funktionalität und ansprechendes Design verbinden. Seit 2018 sind wir auf Amazon zu Hause, jetzt bauen wir TikTok Shop Deutschland von Grund auf neu auf. Ihr besonderes Design macht unsere Reisekissen ideal für Short-Form-Videos mit Wow-Effekt: In wenigen Sekunden sieht man, was sie können.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission

Der kreative Part gehört dir. Du machst aus unserem Rohmaterial Creatives, die hängen bleiben, drehst selbst Short-Form-Videos und sorgst dafür, dass unser Brand Account Woche für Woche konstant postet. Das Ziel ist einfach: unseren Brand-Kanal mit starken, auf TikTok Shop optimierten Videos füllen. Zuschauer sollen kaufen und Creator sehen, welche Angles funktionieren und sich davon inspirieren lassen. Du entscheidest, wie FLOWZOOM auf TikTok aussieht und klingt und arbeitest eng mit unserem TikTok Shop Lead zusammen, der Kanalstrategie und Produktkatalog verantwortet.

Deine Aufgaben

Creatives-Erstellung:

  • Du schneidest Short-Form-Videos aus unserem bestehenden Rohmaterial, aus Material vom Team und aus deinem eigenen Footage (neue Hooks, neue Cuts, TikTok-Style)
  • Du drehst selbst Short-Form-Videos für unseren TikTok Shop Brand Account
  • Du veröffentlichst auf unserem Brand Account, hältst einen konstanten Posting-Rhythmus und gehst in den Austausch mit der Community
  • Du bereitest die besten Videos gemeinsam mit dem Social-Media-Team für Instagram und Facebook auf

Content-Analyse:

  • Du prüfst wöchentlich wie die Videos performt haben und verstehst warum (Hook, Format, CTA und Länge dokumentieren)
  • Du hältst fest, was funktioniert – damit wir Creator-Briefings schärfen, unsere eigenen Videos verbessern und die stärksten Videos mit Ads boosten können
  • Du hältst unsere Video-Bibliothek in Ordnung und dokumentierst systematisch Nutzungsrechte

Unterstützung im Creator Management:

  • Du unterstützt bei Outreach, Onboarding und Aktivierung unserer TikTok-Shop-Affiliate-Creator – zum Beispiel, indem du Briefings verbesserst oder inaktiven Creatorn Beispielvideos schickst

Der Content, den wir im Kopf haben

  • Ein Startpunkt, den du mitgestaltest:
  • Du testest einen Mix aus Formaten: Videos mit dir vor der Kamera, faceless Content (POV, Voiceover, Produkt in Action) sowie Clips von Team und Creatorn
  • Du filterst wiederkehrende Formate heraus: ein paar Serien, die unsere Zuschauer wiedererkennen und für die sie zurückkommen, z. B. „A vs. B"
  • Authentische Travel- und Lifestyle-Momente: das Kissen im echten Leben (Flughafen, Flugzeug, Zug, Roadtrip) – kein reiner Verkaufs-Content
  • Unser Ton: lustig, schnell und abenteuerlustig, aber ehrlich. Wir zeigen, was das Produkt wirklich kann.

Woran wir nach drei Monaten sehen, dass es läuft

  • Unser Account postet konstant 4–5 Videos pro Woche, in einem Format-Mix, der nach FLOWZOOM klingt
  • Wir haben 2–3 wiederkehrende Formate gefunden, die am besten funktionieren
  • Wir kennen unsere Top 3–5 Hooks und Formate – und sie sind dokumentiert
  • Die Video-Bibliothek ist sortiert und bei jedem Clip sind die Nutzungsrechte klar

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

Must-haves:

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Short-Form-Editing – idealerweise ein Portfolio an TikToks, Reels oder Shorts, das du zeigen kannst
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Schnitt-Tools (z. B. CapCut, Premiere oder Final Cut)
  • Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl
  • Du kannst die Performance eines Videos anhand von KPIs analysieren (z. B. Engagement, Retention …)
  • Du hast ein Gespür für TikTok, für Trends und für das, was Leute gern schauen
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und eigenständig
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und du sprichst fließend Englisch (unsere Teamsprache)
  • Du bist immatrikuliert

Nice-to-have:

  • Du nutzt gern AI-Tools, die dir das Leben leichter machen – etwa um bei Ideen, Analyse oder Recherche Zeit zu sparen
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Affiliate- oder Creator-Marketing

Nicht erforderlich:

  • TikTok-Shop-Erfahrung. Ein Hintergrund in Content, Social Media oder E-Commerce zählt genauso.

Konditionen

  • 15–20 Stunden pro Woche, remote, flexible Zeiteinteilung
  • Werkstudium: Wir starten bei 16–18 EUR brutto pro Stunde, das sind rund 1.400–1.550 EUR brutto im Monat bei 20 Stunden/Woche. Wenn es gut läuft, ist Luft nach oben!

Benefits

Wie wir ticken

  • Wir bauen auf der Meinung unserer Kunden auf: Customer Insights und das, was ihr Feedback uns zeigt, sind der Motor für alles, was wir erstellen
  • Wir leben Ownership, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Transparenz
  • Wir arbeiten als Team zusammen – und trotzdem jeder eigenständig und fokussiert
  • Und das Beste: Wir arbeiten 100 % remote und sind flexibel bei den Arbeitszeiten

Was dich erwartet

  • Ownership über unseren Brand-Kanal und unserer Affiliate-Engine: Wir bauen von Grund auf neu und du prägst, wie das aussieht
  • Direktes Feedback: Jede Woche siehst du, was deine Videos erreichen und was deine Arbeit bewirkt
  • Ein internationales, entspanntes Team ohne komplizierte Hierarchien
  • Raus aus der Theorie, rein in die Praxis: Hands-on Erfahrung in der Welt der Creative Economy

Seitdem haben wir uns zu einer führenden Plattform für lokalen Handel entwickelt – und bringen heute alles von Lebensmitteln und Drogerieartikeln über Blumen und Home-&-Living-Produkte bis hin zu Unterhaltungselektronik direkt an die Haustür unserer Kund:innen.

Jetzt ist ein besonders spannender Zeitpunkt, Teil unseres Retail-Teams zu werden. Wolt wächst in Deutschland rasant und arbeitet mit einigen der bekanntesten Handelsmarken des Landes zusammen. Zuletzt haben wir unsere Partnerschaft mit MediaMarktSaturn gestartet: Rund 2.000 Elektronikartikel – von Smartphones bis zu Spielkonsolen – können in großen deutschen Städten, darunter Berlin, innerhalb von etwa 35 Minuten geliefert werden.

Wir bauen unser Retail-Geschäft in Deutschland nun deutlich aus und suchen ambitionierte Sales-Talente, die gemeinsam mit uns die besten lokalen Handelspartner auf die Wolt-Plattform bringen. In dieser Rolle gestaltest du den On-Demand-Handel in Berlin aktiv mit, gewinnst hochwertige Partner und hilfst dabei, neu zu definieren, wie Menschen lokal einkaufen.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Hohe Anpassungsfähigkeit: Du kommunizierst souverän auf Augenhöhe – vom Blumenladen bis zum C-Level-Entscheider. Dabei bleibst du immer authentisch und zielorientiert.
  • Performance-Drive: Du willst der Beste sein und die Top-Retail-Partner der Stadt für Wolt gewinnen, um unseren Marktanteil signifikant auszubauen.
  • Selbstorganisation: Du planst deine Walk-in-Routen effizient, trackst deine Aktivitäten eigenständig und managest deine Pipeline absolut zuverlässig.
  • Positives Mindset: Du bist hartnäckig, denkst lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei Gegenwind deine positive Ausstrahlung.

Nächste Schritte

Unser Bewerbungsprozess ist unkompliziert und transparent:

  1. Recruiter Screening: Ein erstes Gespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team, um dich, deine bisherige Erfahrung und deine Motivation für Wolt kennenzulernen.

In this role, you'll be responsible for designing custom food processing equipment, developing mechanical solutions for plant-based protein manufacturing, and supporting the mechanical engineering needs of our production operations.   • Operational Agility: A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. 

  • Language Proficiency: Fluency in English and/or German, with professional level in the later, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

We’re building something massive—a gentle giant in the food industry. Our team thrives on collaboration, and we believe in the power of face-to-face communication to move fast and work effectively. description:
The Role

This is a senior role combining consulting, technology and commercial responsibility. You’ll work directly with customers to understand their processes and challenges, then turn those requirements into practical Smartsheet solutions. You’ll build and present proof of concepts, scope consulting projects, discuss pricing and ultimately help win the work.
You’ll play an important role in AMX’s continued growth, with an initial focus on the DACH market. You’ll work with opportunities from Smartsheet, our partner network and existing customers, while also helping develop new relationships over time. The focus is on building trust, understanding where AMX can add value and turning strong customer relationships into sustainable growth.
There’s also real scope for this role to grow. With proven success, you’ll take on broader responsibility for how AMX develops opportunities and goes to market, initially through greater ownership of customers, regions and commercial strategy. Over time, this can also develop into mentoring and guiding the team as it grows.What You’ll Be Doing

  • Manage customer opportunities end-to-end, from discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, proof of concepts, scoping, pricing and commercial discussions, before handing over to the implementation team.
  • Build strong relationships with existing customers, identifying new use cases and opportunities to expand successful solutions across other teams, departments and markets.
  • Work closely with Smartsheet Account Executives and the wider Smartsheet team on joint account planning, developing opportunities and identifying growth accounts across DACH and AMX’s wider markets.
  • Help develop new opportunities through targeted account research, strategic outreach, events and collaboration with AMX’s marketing and partner network.
  • Contribute to and help shape AMX’s wider consulting and commercial approach, including how we develop opportunities, work with partners and take solutions to market.
  • As you progress, mentor other consultants and take on increasing responsibility across AMX’s commercial activities.


Your profile

  • You have strong experience in technology consulting, solutions consulting, SaaS or digital transformation.
  • You’re commercially minded and comfortable taking a customer conversation from discovery through solution design, scoping, negotiation and close.
  • You’re equally technically hands-on and comfortable actually building and demonstrating what you propose. Smartsheet experience is a big advantage, but strong Excel skills or experience configuring SaaS, workflow, low-code or business applications can also be a great fit.
  • You’re good at asking the right questions and turning complex or unclear business problems into structured solutions.
  • You’re confident presenting to senior stakeholders and can explain technical solutions in terms of business value.
  • You enjoy building customer relationships and spotting new opportunities.
  • You’re comfortable working without a perfect playbook. You like bringing your own ideas, testing what works and helping shape the processes and approach that will make AMX successful as we grow.
  • You’re interested in growing beyond an individual contributor role, mentoring others and taking on broader responsibility over time.
  • You speak German at native/C2 level and English fluently.
  • You’re ideally based in Germany and comfortable travelling for customers, partner meetings and events, typically up to five days per month.
  • A relevant degree is welcome, but your experience and what you’ve actually delivered are much more important to us.


Why us?

  • You’ll join an established and successful consultancy that is still small enough for you to have a real influence on how things are done.
  • You’ll have genuine flexibility around where you work, with a remote-first setup and only occasional travel for customers, partner meetings and team events.
  • The role comes with a strong fixed salary, with regular salary reviews as your responsibilities and seniority grow.
  • You’ll receive a €3,000 annual learning and development budget, home-office support, a flexible €50 monthly benefits allowance, wellness and technology allowances and regular team retreats.
  • You won’t simply be executing somebody else’s playbook. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, shape how we work and help define what successful growth looks like.
  • Most importantly, there’s room for this to become much more than a typical Senior Consultant position. If things go well, we want you to take on broader commercial responsibility, help develop the team and play an important role in AMX’s continued growth across DACH and beyond.

  • Aufbau und Pflege automatisierter Tests sowie technischer Dokumentation

  • Analyse von Logs und Fehlerbehebung im laufenden Betrieb (Kein Bereitschafts- oder 24/7-Dienst)

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Informatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren MINT-Fach
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python oder einer vergleichbaren Backend-Sprache (z. B. Java, Kotlin, C# oder Go) sowie die Bereitschaft, produktiv mit Python zu arbeiten

  • Du kommunizierst offen und proaktiv

  • Arbeitsplatz in Dortmund im direkten Umfeld der TU Dortmund

We have received 20 million € in round A financing.

Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.

Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy to use). Developing it further takes people who understand what the entrepreneurs on our platform, the Vico Leads, need: they must be able to run their Vico end-to-end without overhead and with minimal effort.

We are scaling our go-to-market and need a leader who wins new business for our Vicos and makes sure our platform does what Vico Leads need.

As Director Business and Digital Product Development you combine three capabilities:

• Business development: you win new clients and business for our Vicos

• Digital product development: you turn user needs into requirements that our engineers turn into platform capabilities

• Entrepreneurial drive in building a hyper-scaling business: this is about continuously driving the perfection of our product, go-to-market, processes and tools

You join our go-to-market team and work closely with our platform building team. Your work directly affects how well thousands of freelance experts can run their own companies on our platform.

Tasks

Shape the market

• Position Vicoland with enterprise clients as the strategic alternative to traditional professional services models.

• Question established sourcing models and demonstrate why Vicos deliver better outcomes.

• Develop go-to-market strategies tailored to specific client contexts.

• Build thought leadership through events and LinkedIn presence.

Win and grow clients

• Develop and own a portfolio of enterprise clients and partners – from strategic outreach through close to long-term expansion.

• Win new business together with Vico Leads, and learn from every deal what the platform must do better.

Lead and enable Vico Leads

• Be the go-to person for Vico Leads on the platform: help them solve problems, and bring in engineering where needed.

• Supervise and coach Vico Leads in your client group – hold them accountable for delivery quality and commercial performance.

• Activate new Vico Leads and help them grow their own marketplace business on the platform.

Continuously define the platform and shape the company

• Translate the real problems, needs and workflows of Vico Leads into concrete requirements and feature requests for our engineering team.

• Prioritize features by impact on business and shape the platform roadmap.

• Follow each feature to release, check whether it works for Vico Leads, and drive our NPS.

• Bring market intelligence, client feedback, and competitive insight into the organization and our product.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Ceph / On-Prem Cloud Storage (m/f/d)
description:
Your Role

You will help us build, operate and industrialize the storage foundation of our on-premise cloud platform. As part of a small, experienced team, you will own the Ceph clusters behind our block, object and file storage services – essentially the storage every customer workload eventually lands on. The platform is still actively being built, which means you will have real influence on the storage architecture, hardware lifecycle, automation strategy and technical direction. The role goes beyond Ceph itself: you will regularly work across bare metal, networking, OpenStack, Kubernetes and GitOps. As a Senior Engineer, you take ownership of your area and help make storage predictable, durable and highly automated as we scale into the petabytes

Unser Tech Stack 🚀

· Ceph · OpenStack · Kubernetes · KVM · Linux · Bare Metal · Ansible · Terraform · Go · Cinder ·Neutron · Nova · RBD · Cilium
· RGW/ S3 · Prometheus/ Grafana · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Git· Python · Claude Code · Cursor · Agentic Coding Tooling

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, operate and evolve our Ceph clusters for block, object / S3 and file storage - from CRUSH topology and failure domains to pool design, placement groups, erasure coding, capacity headroom and performance.

  • Own the storage hardware lifecycle end to end – from qualification and burn-in through firmware, controller and disk health to OSD add/drain/replace, node retirement and hardware refresh. A key part of the job is automating these processes without creating tenant-visible impact.

  • Automate the provisioning of storage nodes on OpenStack-managed bare metal, working with Ironic, RAID and disk configuration, SEDs, provider networks and VLANs. You will also own the artefact path around images, package mirrors, certificates and other dependencies needed to bring up clusters in environments with tightly controlled external connectivity.

  • Run upgrades, rebalancing and reconfigurations as routine production operations, evolve our Infrastructure as Code and GitOps setup with Ansible, Terraform and FluxCD / ArgoCD, and make sure storage integrates cleanly with both OpenStack and Kubernetes.

  • Own capacity planning and growth forecasting, use telemetry to understand real consumption, and build out monitoring, testing and failure-injection around performance, durability and security.

  • AI-assisted engineering is simply part of how we work today. You use LLMs and agentic tools where they genuinely help – across development, testing, reviews, incident triage, knowledge retrieval or automation - and help us push further into self-healing and auto-remediation.

  • Act as a technical reference and sparring partner across Ceph, storage, automation and AI tooling, document technical decisions and share your knowledge with the team.

What we offer

  • Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam

  • Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies

  • 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service

  • Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation

  • Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package

  • OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs

  • Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities (gym membership, sports classes, etc.)

  • Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies

  • We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike

  • Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages

  • Several years of hands-on experience as an SRE, Storage Engineer or Platform Engineer running production storage infrastructure, with solid experience deploying, operating and debugging Ceph in production.

  • You know the Ceph fundamentals from real-world operations: CRUSH, pools and placement groups, replication vs. erasure coding, BlueStore, scrubbing, recovery and backfill under load.

  • You have managed storage infrastructure end to end, from the physical layer with drives, firmware, BIOS, controllers and hardware diagnostics through rebalancing, host drains, capacity expansion and hardware generation migrations.

  • You are comfortable using Kubernetes as a control plane, not only as a workload runtime, and understand operators/controllers, custom resources, reconciliation and GitOps. You can also move confidently around OpenStack and debug issues involving Ironic, Neutron, Nova or Glance when needed.

  • You have dealt with situations where durability really matters – such as degraded or near-full clusters, recovery under load or split-brain conditions – and you are used to making changes in a staged, evidence-based and reversible way.

  • You have strong Linux and bare-metal skills, understand the block layer, filesystems and I/O behaviour, and are comfortable working with Ansible, Terraform and GitOps.

  • AI-assisted engineering is already part of your day-to-day work. You have practical experience with LLMs and agentic tools and know where they can meaningfully support development, testing, reviews or operations.

  • Ideally, you also bring experience with RGW / S3, RBD mirroring, CephFS or ceph-csi, deeper OpenStack storage integrations and Go and/or Python. Experience around VLAN/BGP, storage performance tuning, NVMe/BlueStore, observability, data protection, encryption, auto-remediation, security baselines or multi-site storage is also relevant for the role.

  • You work autonomously, bring a strong sense of ownership, and are comfortable debugging problems where the actual root cause may sit somewhere between storage, networking, Kubernetes and OpenStack. You would rather verify what is happening from evidence than assume how the system should behave.

  • We work in an international environment in English, so you should feel comfortable discussing technical topics, documenting decisions and working with the team in English.

  • Bonus: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du einen vom Unternehmenserfolg abhängigen Jahresbonus, der in erfolgreichen Jahren bereits bei mehreren Tausend Euro lag.  

  • Mobilität: Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine.

title: Founding Product Manager
description:
Hi, we're Dana and Erik, the founders of Circonomit. We build the decision platform industrial companies use to plan their production.

Dana sees the customer side. She needs to know which use cases we can sell today, which we cannot, and what a demo is allowed to claim.

Erik sees the engineering side. He needs requirements that are ready to be built, complete, and clear about what we deliberately leave out.

The product sits between the two, and that is this role. We sell vertically, one use case at a time, while the product has to stay general enough to serve the next customer without being rebuilt. You decide what we build next, in which order, and what we decline.

How you will be measured: how much of today's project work is standard product a year from now, and how quickly a recognised customer problem becomes a usable capability.

We came out of RWTH research, raised €2.8M with Vorwerk Ventures, and have customers running on our models today. Small team, Cologne office.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in product management, or consulting with genuine product proximity. You have owned a product area end to end, not only a backlog.
  • A technical and analytical foundation: engineering, data, operations research, quantitative controlling, or finance with real modelling.
  • You recognise when a requirement creates technical debt or will not be reusable at the next customer. You will not write production code.
  • Experience deciding under incomplete information, and explaining the trade-offs afterwards: what you chose, why, and what it cost.
  • You are comfortable working directly with plant managers and controllers, and understand how they decide today.
  • German at C1 level or above, and fluent English. Customer conversations happen in German.
  • Existing work visa for Germany.

You should enjoy being in front of customers in your first week, and deciding without a research team behind you. Priorities change as we learn from customers, and we make scope and trade-offs explicit together.

Benefits

  • Ownership. The roadmap, and where the line between product and customer project sits.
  • Shaping the role. This is the founding product role. You define how product works here: discovery, prioritisation, and the standards between product and engineering.
  • Exposure. You present your roadmap and the reasoning behind it to the board, and you sit in the core strategy conversations.
  • Real-world impact. Customers plan their production on our models today.
  • Direct collaboration. Small team, no org chart. We work directly together. Weekly feedback, both ways.
  • Compensation. Competitive salary plus a VSOP package reflecting your contribution and development in the role.
  • Hybrid work. Our HQ is in Cologne, and we meet there regularly.
  • Your setup and everyday extras. Hardware of your choice · AI tooling budget · sports membership · Deutschland-Ticket.

Process: An intro call, a second conversation with the team, a 60- to 90-minute live case on a real customer requirement, then in-person conversations with the team.

"Hustle the day, analyse at night, reinforce something outstanding." Period.

title: Praktikum Social Media, Content & Community bei Try It (m/w/d)

Die Jacke, die du ständig trägst. Das Secondhand-Teil, für das dir noch eine Kombination fehlt. Ein Blick in einen anderen Kleiderschrank – und plötzlich eine Idee für deinen eigenen.

Your wardrobe has more in it.

Ich bin Christopher, Gründer von Try It. Ich entwickle eine App, mit der du deine Kleidung erfassen, Outfits zusammenstellen und neue Möglichkeiten in deiner eigenen Garderobe entdecken kannst. Was du davon trägst, entscheidest du.

Jetzt suche ich jemanden, der Lust hat, Try It mit mir sichtbar zu machen und eine Community mit aufzubauen. Du bringst deinen Blick auf Mode und Menschen mit. Ich bringe die App, die Geschichte dahinter und mich selbst ein.

Wenn du sagst: „Christopher, zeig das mal“ oder „Ich würde das anders erzählen“, bin ich dabei.

Aufgaben

Was du mitgestalten kannst

Deine Schwerpunkte vereinbaren wir passend zu deinen Erfahrungen, Lernzielen und deiner verfügbaren Zeit.

  • Eigene Inhalte entwickeln und umsetzen. Ein Lieblingsteil anders kombinieren oder zeigen, was tatsächlich im Reisekoffer landet: Du erkennst solche Momente und machst daraus Reels, TikToks oder Storys. Try It wird dabei in echter Nutzung sichtbar.
  • Vor und hinter der Kamera mitwirken. Du entwickelst Formate, filmst und gestaltest Inhalte. Gerne kannst du selbst ausprobieren, erzählen und zeigen oder mich in deine Ideen einbeziehen. Deine Art und dein Humor sind willkommen.
  • Menschen zur Beteiligung einladen. Du greifst Fragen, Geschichten und Outfit-Ideen auf. Daraus können Gespräche, kleine gemeinsame Aktionen und wiederkehrende Formate entstehen.
  • Passende Creator kennenlernen. Du entdeckst Menschen mit einer interessanten Stilwelt und einer echten Verbindung zu ihrer Community. Gemeinsam bereiten wir persönliche Ansprachen vor und entwickeln bei gegenseitigem Interesse Ideen für eine Zusammenarbeit.
  • Beobachtungen zurückbringen. Was haben Menschen wiedererkannt? Was wollten sie ausprobieren? Wo blieb eine Frage offen? Deine Eindrücke helfen dabei, Inhalte und die App weiterzuentwickeln.

Dabei soll Platz für unterschiedliche Menschen, Körper, Budgets und Geschmäcker entstehen. Wer seine Kleidung zeigt, erzählt seine eigene Geschichte und entscheidet selbst, was gefällt.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

Du interessierst dich für Mode, persönlichen Stil und die Menschen dahinter. Du hast Lust, Try It kennenzulernen und mit deiner eigenen Garderobe auszuprobieren.

Erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Inhalten oder Community-Arbeit sind wichtig. Vielleicht hast du einen eigenen Kanal bewusst weiterentwickelt, einen Account mitbetreut, ein kreatives Projekt umgesetzt oder Menschen rund um ein gemeinsames Interesse zusammengebracht. Auch ein kleines Projekt zählt.

Darauf kommt es mir an:

  • Sprachgefühl und kulturelles Gespür: Du drückst dich auf Deutsch klar und persönlich aus. Du verstehst die Sprache und den Humor von Communities, die dich interessieren, und merkst, wenn eine Ansprache aufgesetzt wirkt.
  • Eigeninitiative und Verlässlichkeit: Du bringst Ideen ein, organisierst vereinbarte Aufgaben selbstständig und meldest dich rechtzeitig, wenn du Unterstützung brauchst.
  • Urteilsvermögen: Du kannst begründen, weshalb ein Inhalt oder ein Creator zu Try It passt, und fragst nach, wenn dir etwas unklar oder wenig glaubwürdig erscheint.
  • Neugier und Offenheit: Du möchtest dazulernen, kannst Feedback annehmen und gibst mir genauso ehrlich Rückmeldung. Auch bei Kritik bleibst du respektvoll.

Freude an der Arbeit vor der Kamera und erste Erfahrungen mit Videoschnitt oder Gestaltungstools sind willkommen. Du musst nicht alles schon beherrschen und brauchst keine große eigene Reichweite.

Benefits

Was du hier aufbauen kannst

Du arbeitest direkt mit mir als Gründer zusammen und bekommst Einblick in die Produkt- und Markenentwicklung. Zu Beginn vereinbaren wir Lernziele und einen überschaubaren Aufgabenbereich. Regelmäßiger Austausch und Feedback gehören dazu.

Gemeinsam halten wir fest, welche veröffentlichten Inhalte und Projekte du später als eigene Arbeitsbeispiele für dein Portfolio zeigen kannst.

Die Produktion soll im Alltag machbar bleiben: Smartphone, verständlicher Ton, ein echter Raum und eine gute Beobachtung können bereits reichen. Ein gelungener Moment darf einfach sein.

Rahmen und Vergütung

Du arbeitest vollständig remote. Beginn, Dauer und verlässliche Wochenstunden vereinbaren wir miteinander; Teilzeit ist möglich. Ein Pflichtpraktikum kommt ebenfalls infrage.

Das Praktikum ist unbezahlt. Es kommt deshalb nur infrage, wenn die rechtlichen Voraussetzungen für deine konkrete Praktikumsform erfüllt sind. Das klären wir vor Beginn.

Try It befindet sich im Aufbau. Ich verdiene damit aktuell selbst noch nichts und kann derzeit keine Vergütung anbieten. Das soll vor deiner Bewerbung klar sein.

Wenn es für beide Seiten passt und die wirtschaftlichen Voraussetzungen entstehen, möchte ich daraus eine bezahlte, langfristige Zusammenarbeit machen. Eine Zusage dafür kann ich heute noch nicht geben.

Lust, mitzugestalten?

Bewirb dich direkt über JOIN mit deinem Lebenslauf oder einem kurzen Überblick über deinen bisherigen Weg. Dazu interessieren mich drei Dinge:

  • Was spricht dich an Try It an?
  • Was hast du schon gestaltet, veröffentlicht oder mit aufgebaut? Was war dein Beitrag, und was hast du dabei gelernt?
  • Welche Community oder welchen Creator findest du spannend – und was macht den Austausch dort für dich besonders?

Vorhandene Videos, Texte oder Projektlinks schaue ich mir gerne an. Nenne bitte auch deinen möglichen Starttermin, den gewünschten Zeitraum und die Stunden, die du pro Woche verlässlich einbringen kannst.

Für die erste Bewerbung brauchst du kein neues Konzept und kein Bewerbungsvideo. Nach einem ersten Kennenlernen kann in der engeren Auswahl eine kleine Arbeitsprobe folgen: höchstens zwei Stunden Aufwand bei sieben Tagen Abgabefrist. Sie dient unserem Auswahlgespräch und wird nicht veröffentlicht oder als Content genutzt.

Ich freue mich darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Christopher
Gründer von Try It

description:
Du möchtest nicht nur Daten verarbeiten, sondern eine moderne Datenplattform entwickeln, die Analysen, Reporting und datengetriebene Entscheidungen im gesamten Unternehmen ermöglicht? 

Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein. 

Unser Kunde, ein dynamisch wachsende E-Commerce Service Agentur in Berlin, zählt zu den erfolgreichsten Amazon-Händlern Deutschlands und vertreibt tausende Produkte 

Für den weiteren Ausbau der Data & Analytics Landschaft wird eine Persönlichkeit gesucht, die moderne Datenarchitekturen entwickelt und den Weg zu einer datengetriebenen Organisation aktiv mitgestaltet 

Deine Benefits

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.  

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Home-Office Tagen, einer 40-Stunden-Woche, Gleitzeit mit Arbeitsbeginn zwischen 6:00 und 10:00 Uhr.  

  • Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag sowie 30 Urlaubstage in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen.  

  • Weiterentwicklung: Ob fachlich oder persönlich – deine Entwicklung wird aktiv gefördert und langfristig begleitet.  

  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Freue dich auf ein modernes Büro im Berliner Bezirk Lichtenberg.  

  • Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro.  

  • Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation, eine gelebte Du-Kultur und regelmäßige Team- sowie Firmenevents wie „Grill & Chill“ sorgen für ein starkes Miteinander.  

  • Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir im Arbeitsalltag jederzeit zur Verfügung.  

  • Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Data Engineer entwickelst und betreibst du moderne Datenplattformen in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric und sorgst dafür, dass hochwertige Daten zuverlässig für Analysen, Reporting und Machine-Learning-Anwendungen bereitstehen. 

  • Data Engineering: Konzeption, Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung moderner Datenpipelines in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric.  

  • Datenqualität: Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität, Vollständigkeit und Reproduzierbarkeit sowie Implementierung effizienter inkrementeller Datenladeprozesse.  

  • Datenintegration: Entwicklung und Pflege effizienter ETL-/ELT-Prozesse sowie API-basierter Datenintegrationen.  

  • Plattformbetrieb: Entwicklung robuster Monitoring-, Logging- und Fehlerbehandlungskonzepte sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung von Performance, Kosten und Datenworkflows.  

  • Data Architecture: Mitarbeit am Aufbau einer skalierbaren Datenarchitektur inklusive Test-, Staging- und Produktionsumgebungen sowie moderner Technologien wie CI/CD, Fabric Pipelines, dbt oder Airflow.  

  • Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Data & Analytics und den Data Analysts zur Bereitstellung hochwertiger Daten für Power BI Dashboards und Machine-Learning-Modelle. 

Dein Profil als Data Engineer

  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Datenpipelines oder Datenplattformen – idealerweise auf Senior-Level, motivierte Mid-Level-Profile sind ebenfalls willkommen.  

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure Data Services, insbesondere Data Factory und/oder Azure Synapse; idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric.  

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Python, insbesondere im Bereich ETL-/ELT-Prozesse und Automatisierung.  

  • Erfahrung in der Datenmodellierung, idealerweise mit Bronze-, Silver- und Gold-Layer-Architekturen.  

  • Kenntnisse im Datenqualitätsmanagement sowie in Monitoring, Logging und Performance-Optimierung.  

  • Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Umsetzung technischer Projekte sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.  

  • Ausgeprägte Teamorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld.  

  • Fließende Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse. Bei geringeren Deutschkenntnissen (ab B1) werden dafür sehr gute Englischkenntnisse vorausgesetzt.  

Nice-to-haves – jedes zusätzliche Know-how ist ein Pluspunkt:

  • Erfahrung mit inkrementellen Ladeprozessen und Delta-Verarbeitung.  

  • Erfahrung in der Datenintegration für Power BI sowie im Umgang mit semantischen Modellen.  

  • Kenntnisse im E-Commerce- oder Amazon-Umfeld.  

  • Erfahrung mit API-basierten Datenintegrationen.  

  • Kenntnisse in CI/CD, z. B. mit GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps.  

  • Interesse an Machine Learning und dem Aufbau datengetriebener Organisationen.  

  • Erfahrung mit Openbridge.

termios macht Heizen in Wohn- und Gewerbeimmobilien smarter und klimafreundlicher. Unser Thermostat spart spürbar Energie und hilft Asset Managern, Wohnungsunternehmen und Eigentümern, ihre ESG- und Net-Zero-Ziele zu erreichen.

Unser Produkt — termios Pro — ist ein cloud-vernetztes Smart-Thermostat, das Wohnungsbaugesellschaften hilft, verifizierbaren CO₂- und Energieverbrauch in ihrem Bestand zu senken.

Warum wir diese Stelle besetzen

Unser Algorithmik-Team hat Daten aus zigtausend verbauten Thermostaten und kann aus Theorie und Daten Verfahren entwickeln, auswerten und ausrollen. Hier arbeitest du mit – mit deinem Hintergrund entwickelst du Verfahren mit und beurteilst, ob eine Idee der Begegnung mit realer Gebäudehydraulik, verschiedenen Wärmeerzeugern (Fernwärme-Übergabestation, WP etc.) und den unterschiedlichen Regelungssystemen im Feld standhält.

Aufgaben

  • Hydraulik und Anlagentypen bewerten: Egal ob Einrohr- und Zweirohrsysteme, Fernwärme (inkl. Rücklauftemperaturbegrenzung und Netzanforderungen), Anlagen mit Strangregulier- und Differenzdruckregelventile sowie Voreinstellungen und kv-Werte - Du kennst Dich mit der Hydraulik unterschiedlicher Anlagentypen aus und kannst beurteilen, welche Anforderungen sich daraus für unsere Verfahren ergeben.
  • Machbarkeit beurteilen: Du bewertest algorithmische und methodische Ideen daraufhin, ob sie anlagentechnisch tragfähig sind — und sagst früh, wenn eine Annahme an der Realität vorbeigeht.
  • Feldtests konzipieren und durchführen: Du baust Testszenarien in realen Gebäuden auf, steuerst sie, misst und bewertest die Ergebnisse.
  • Messdaten lesen und auswerten: Wir erfassen zwar viele Messwerte, manches ist aber nicht direkt abzulesen - am Heizkörper gibt es in der Regel weder Volumenstrommessung noch Rücklauffühler. Du weißt, auf welche physikalischen Zusammenhänge es ankommt und kannst die vorhandenen Messwerte dahingehend richtig lesen und interpretieren.
  • Verfahren formalisieren: Du unterstützt uns, physikalische Zusammenhänge und Berechnungsvorschriften in eine implementierbare Form zu bringen. — mit definierten Eingangsgrößen, Randbedingungen, Gültigkeitsbereichen und einer fehlenden oder unplausiblen Werten passieren soll.
  • Fachliche Referenz sein: intern für Entwicklung und Produkt, bei Bedarf auch im Austausch mit Wohnungswirtschaft, Fachplanung und Handwerk.

Qualifikation

  • Entweder ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Versorgungstechnik, Technischer Gebäudeausrüstung, Gebäude- und Energietechnik, Maschinenbau oder Verfahrenstechnik,
    oder — alternativ – Techniker- oder Meisterqualifikation mit entsprechender Praxis.
  • Nachgewiesene Praxis an Heizungsanlagen im Bestand: Planung, Inbetriebnahme, Optimierung oder Betriebsführung. Du hast hydraulischen Abgleich, Heizkurveneinstellung und Störungssuche selbst gemacht, nicht nur darüber gelesen.
  • Erfahrung mit Algorithmen- und Logikentwicklung: Du hast schon einmal eine Berechnungs- oder Regelvorschrift so aufgeschrieben, so dass jemand anderes sie umsetzen konnte — als Auslegungsrechnung, Simulationsmodell, Excel-Werkzeug oder Regelstrategie.
  • Erfahrung mit Messtechnik und Inbetriebnahme — Du weißt, wie man eine Messung so ansetzt, dass sie am Ende sinnvolle Werte liefern kann.
  • Bereitschaft, datengetrieben zu arbeiten: die Gewohnheit, eine Vermutung über ein Gebäude in eine auswertbare Fragestellung zu übersetzen. Vorerfahrung ist ein Plus, die Bereitschaft ist die Anforderung.
  • Bereitschaft, auch vor Ort unterwegs zu sein — die Rolle lebt vom Wechsel zwischen Heizungskeller und Schreibtisch.
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch auf Arbeitsniveau (Teamsprache).

Was Du nicht brauchst

Du musst nicht programmieren können. Keine Machine-Learning-Erfahrung, keine IoT-Vorkenntnisse, keine Embedded-Kenntnisse. Diese Kompetenzen sind im Team.
Wenn Du Dich in der Anlagentechnik zu Hause fühlst und bereit bist, Dich in Daten einzuarbeiten, bist Du richtig.

Benefits

  • Echten Einfluss darauf, was gebaut wird. Wir entwickeln ein neus Produkt und Du kannst es direkt mitgestalten.
  • Alles unter einem Dach: Hardware, Firmware, Funk, Cloud und Daten. Wer das gebaut hat, wonach Du fragst, sitzt im selben Team.
  • Ein Messdatenbestand aus tausenden Wohnungen — die Möglichkeit, Fragen zu beantworten, die sich an einem einzelnen Gebäude nicht beantworten lassen.
  • Feldzugang als Teil der Rolle, nicht als Ausnahme. Wenn Du eine Idee an einem realen Strang prüfen willst, organisieren wir das.
  • Unbefristete Festanstellung mit wettbewerbsfähiger Vergütung, 30 Tage Urlaub, dank der Joint-Venture Partner mehr Team-Events und Parties als üblich

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, and Flex combined. title: Finance Process & Systems Lead
description:
Finance Process & Systems Lead

Our mission for you

Build the systems and process backbone of the Finance function in one of the most complex industries – and shape how Finance can be run differently.

trawa is transforming how mid-sized companies access green, intelligent energy. That means building in a market shaped by decades-old logic, extensive regulation, and highly complex data structures: 15-minute time series, PPAs, spot, futures, and direct marketing. All of this needs to flow into Finance in a way that is accurate, efficient, and scalable.

We're looking for a Finance Process & Systems Lead to take real ownership of how Finance operates, scales, and automates at trawa. This is a blue-sky role: you'll design our system landscape, redesign core processes end to end, lead the Finance side of our ERP rollout, and turn AI and automation from side experiments into core infrastructure.

You'll work closely with the Finance team across all functions, as well as Business Operations, Tech, Data, and other key stakeholders, to build the foundations that allow Finance to scale with the business.

What you'll own

Finance systems and IT transformation

  • Own trawa's Finance technology stack end to end – from today's fragmented landscape to a fully integrated stack built around a modern cloud ERP.

  • Lead the broader Finance IT transformation, including architecture, vendor selection, integrations, and the roadmap for our ERP, billing system, and future Finance tools.

  • Drive requirements, implementation, and go-live from the systems side. For accounting-heavy topics, you'll work closely with the Accounting Lead, who brings the required technical depth.

Process redesign, automation, and AI

Your biggest lever in the first 12 months will be to structurally redesign Quote-to-Cash for our energy business.

  • Redesign our core Finance processes end to end – including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report – with scalability, controls by design, and automation built in from the start.

  • Own the automation roadmap: define what gets automated, in which order, and with what expected return on investment.

  • Drive month-end close automation and establish time to close as a measurable performance indicator.

  • Turn AI and workflow automation into reliable Finance infrastructure rather than isolated experiments.

Data and the Finance–Tech bridge

  • Own Finance master data and the Finance layer of our data warehouse, from source systems and governance through to reporting-ready tables.

  • Translate energy-specific data – including time series, accruals, and portfolio pricing – into Finance-grade structures together with Tech, Data, and Business Operations.

  • Establish the data models, governance, and quality standards that enable reliable reporting and scalable Finance processes.

  • Month 1 – Understand and map: Get deep into our business model, the energy market, and our Finance systems and process landscape. Meet key stakeholders across Finance, Business Operations, Tech, and Data. Map Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report end to end, and identify the most critical system and data pain points.

  • Month 2 – Take first ownership: Own the automation roadmap and deliver one meaningful automation or process improvement. Take ownership of Finance master data governance and begin scoping the strategic IT landscape and Finance transformation.

  • Month 3 – Own the roadmap: Own the Finance systems, process, and automation roadmap end to end. Present a concrete direction and rollout plan for the IT transformation. Define the target data model together with the relevant cross-functional stakeholders.

Who you are

Must-haves

  • 6+ years of experience in Finance Systems, Finance Processes, or FinOps in a fast-growing scale-up. You've built and improved systems and processes – not just operated them.

  • A proven track record of redesigning Quote-to-Cash in a complex environment with multiple product logics, numerous data sources, high volumes, and regulatory complexity. You also have a solid understanding of Procure-to-Pay and Record-to-Report.

  • Hands-on ERP implementation experience with a modern cloud ERP. You've personally owned requirements, process design, data migration, cutover, or hypercare.

  • Technical fluency to build, not just specify: You use SQL and Python in live workflows and are comfortable working with REST APIs, webhooks, and direct data access rather than relying only on standard reports.

  • An AI-first mindset with a track record: You've redesigned real processes using AI agents and workflow automation and have hands-on experience with tools such as Claude Code, n8n, or comparable solutions.

  • Experience designing master data and data warehouse structures: You've established Finance data models, governance, and quality rules and worked with Tech or BI to build a commercially usable data warehouse layer, from source systems through to reporting-ready tables.

  • An ownership mindset and business-fluent English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in the energy market, utilities, or trading. This will noticeably reduce your time to value.

  • An accounting qualification or background, such as CPA, ACCA, Bilanzbuchhalter:in, or Wirtschaftsprüfer:in.

  • German language skills.

Don't worry if you don't match every box. We value ownership, build instinct, and learning speed over perfect CVs.

What we offer

  • Blue-sky design authority: Work in one of Europe's most complex energy markets, with the opportunity to design Finance infrastructure from the ground up rather than maintain a legacy stack or legacy processes.

  • A role that grows with the company: trawa is scaling fast, and our Finance organisation is scaling with it. This role comes with genuine headroom: as the function grows around you, so do your scope, your team, and your seniority.

  • The opportunity to lead the Finance side of our ERP rollout: a milestone that will shape the company for the next decade.

  • The chance to build a truly AI-first Finance stack.

  • A uniquely complex business model at the intersection of energy, technology, and finance.

As Head of Customer for DACH at Hawk, you own everything that happens with our customers in your territory: the outcomes (GRR, NRR), the operating model that makes delivery repeatable, and the people who run it. Much of the operational discipline, the services products, systems, and tools that make execution scalable, is still being built globally, and you're a core contributor to that single, globally deployable model, not the architect of a regional one.
